items.idea: Why do you get a Bruise?
items.notes: Talk about what a bruise is and the different types and the reasons why it appears. Go into depth on a biological level too. And talk about different levels of severity and the recovery progress. Give some tips on how to recover from a bruise faster.

items.idea: Why do Dogs Sleep So Much?
items.notes: Like compare how much dogs sleeps to humans and explain why dogs sleep a lot longer. Like explain why they sleep much longer and compare to sleep times of other animals. Compare domestic dogs with wolves in the wild also.
